haiku.problem: Jotham's survival is a minor detail. The main event, Abimelech killing his seventy brothers on one stone (card 2-13), was left out. Also, "He was away in Shechem" is not clearly false: Jotham goes up Mount Gerizim, which overlooks Shechem, so the passage does not rule out that he was nearby.
The fig tree's refusal is a minor detail of the parable. The thornbush's answer (card 2-10), the parable's key point, was left out.
